english.title: Driver of hackney carriage fail to wear / produce badge
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a driver licenced under section 8 of the Hackney Carriages Act 1843,

(A)_[failed at all times during your employment to wear your badge issued under that section conspicuously upon your breast, in such manner that the whole of the writing thereon was distinctly legible]_
(B)_[failed, when required to attend before a justice of the peace, to wear your badge issued under that section conspicuously upon your breast, in such manner that the whole of the writing thereon was distinctly legible]_
(C)_[refused to produce your badge issued under that section for inspection when required to do so]_
(D)_[refused to permit a person to note the writing upon your badge issued under that section when required to do so]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 17 of the London Hackney Carriages Act 1843.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
